docs.title: Cross-Platform PDE Solver Framework
docs.text: PETSc-based structured grid PDE solvers with manufactured solution (MMS) verification — supporting Poisson, Heat, and Stokes equations across 3 grid types.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
# Build all solvers
cd build && cmake .. && make -j8

# Run a solver with convergence check
./poisson_vertex_2D -nx 64 -ny 64 -mms sinpi -poisson_check_error
./heat_vertex_2D -nx 64 -ny 64 -mms cospi -bc_type NNNN -heat_check_error
./stokes_projection_2D -nx 32 -ny 32 -stokes_check_error

docs.title: Vertex-Centered Poisson Solver
docs.text: Steady-state Poisson equation on a vertex-centered (DMDA) grid. Supports Dirichlet and Neumann BCs with 3 manufactured solutions.

docs.title: 1. Governing Equation
docs.text:
\[-\Delta u = f \quad \text{in } \Omega = [0,1]^2\]

Manufactured solutions (MMS):

Name \(u(x,y)\) \(f = -\Delta u\) Default BC sinpi \(\sin(\pi x)\sin(\pi y)\) \(2\pi^2\sin(\pi x)\sin(\pi y)\) DDDD poly2 \(x^2 + y^2\) \(-4\) DDDD cospi \(\cos(\pi x)\cos(\pi y)\) \(2\pi^2\cos(\pi x)\cos(\pi y)\) NNNN

Boundary conditions set via -bc_type LRTB (e.g. -bc_type DNDN = Dirichlet left/right, Neumann bottom/top).

docs.title: 2. Discretization
docs.text:
• Grid: \(N_x \times N_y\) vertices at \((i h_x, j h_y)\), \(h_x = 1/(N_x-1)\), \(h_y = 1/(N_y-1)\)
  • Stencil: 5-point Laplacian, interior diagonal \(2(h_x^{-2}+h_y^{-2})\)
  • Dirichlet BC: Identity row at boundary vertices
  • Neumann BC: Ghost-cell reflection with \(2/h^2\) coefficients, RHS \(= f + 2g/h\)
  • All-Neumann: Pin corner \((0,0)\) to exact value (removes constant nullspace)
  • Solver: GMRES + ILU, tolerance \(10^{-10}\)

||u-u_ex||=2.54973e-05

docs.title: Cell-Centered Poisson Solver
docs.text: Steady-state Poisson on a cell-centered (DMStag) grid. Ghost-cell method for boundary conditions.

docs.title: 1. Governing Equation
docs.text: \(-\Delta u = f\) on \([0,1]^2\). Same 3 MMS as vertex Poisson.

docs.title: 2. Discretization
docs.text:
• Grid: \(N_x \times N_y\) cells, centers at \(((i+0.5)h, (j+0.5)h)\), \(h = 1/N\)
  • Stencil: 5-point Laplacian at cell centers
  • Dirichlet BC: Ghost cell \(u_{-1} = 2g - u_0\) → diagonal \(+1/h^2\), RHS \(+2g/h^2\)
  • Neumann BC: Ghost cell \(u_{-1} = u_0 + hg\) → diagonal \(-1/h^2\), RHS \(+g/h\)
  • All-Neumann: Pin cell \((0,0)\) to exact value
  • Solver: GMRES + ILU, tolerance \(10^{-10}\)

docs.title: Staggered Poisson Solver
docs.text: Mixed first-order formulation on a staggered (MAC) grid. DOFs: \(u\) (cell centers), \(g_x\) (x-faces), \(g_y\) (y-faces).

docs.title: 1. Governing Equation
docs.text:
First-order system equivalent to \(-\Delta u = f\):

\[g_x = \frac{\partial u}{\partial x},\quad g_y = \frac{\partial u}{\partial y},\quad -\left(\frac{\partial g_x}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial g_y}{\partial y}\right) = f\]

Same 3 MMS as vertex Poisson.

docs.title: 2. Discretization
docs.text:
• Grid: \(N_x \times N_y\) cells, \(g_x\) at \(x = i h\), \(g_y\) at \(y = j h\), \(u\) at cell centers, \(h = 1/N\)
  • System: Saddle-point matrix \(\begin{bmatrix} I & -G \\ -D & 0 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} g \\ u \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} b_g \\ f \end{bmatrix}\)
  • Dirichlet BC: \(g_x - \frac{2}{h}u_0 = -\frac{2}{h}g\) at boundary faces (one-sided gradient)
  • Neumann BC: \(g_x = \mp g\) at boundary faces (identity row, no \(u\) coupling)
  • All-Neumann: Pin \(u(0,0)\) with identity row
  • Solver: PCLU (direct solver — saddle-point needs it), \(10^{-8}\) regularization on \(u\)-block

docs.title: Vertex-Centered Heat Solver
docs.text: Time-dependent heat equation on a vertex-centered (DMDA) grid. Implicit Euler with \(\Delta t = h^2\).

docs.title: 1. Governing Equation
docs.text:
\[\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} = \alpha\Delta u + f, \quad \alpha = 0.1\]

Implicit Euler: \((I - \alpha\Delta t\Delta) u^{n+1} = u^n + \Delta t\,f^{n+1}\)

Manufactured solutions (time-dependent):

Name \(u(x,y,t)\) \(f\) sinpi \(e^{-2\pi^2\alpha t}\sin(\pi x)\sin(\pi y)\) \(0\) poly2 \(x^2 + y^2\) (steady) \(-4\alpha\) cospi \(e^{-2\pi^2\alpha t}\cos(\pi x)\cos(\pi y)\) \(0\)

docs.title: 2. Discretization
docs.text:
• Grid: \(N_x \times N_y\) vertices, \(h = 1/(N-1)\)
  • Time: \(\Delta t = h^2\), \(T_{\text{final}} = 0.05\)
  • Matrix: Helmholtz \(I - \alpha\Delta t\Delta_h\) — 5-point stencil + identity
  • Dirichlet BC: Identity row, RHS \(= u_{\text{exact}}(x,y,t^{n+1})\)
  • Neumann BC: Same stencil as Poisson, RHS \(= u^n + \Delta t\,f + 2\alpha\Delta t\,g/h\)
  • Solver: GMRES + ILU, tolerance \(10^{-12}\)

\(I - \alpha\Delta t\Delta\) is positive definite — no pin needed for all-Neumann.

docs.title: Staggered Heat Solver
docs.text: Heat equation in mixed first-order form on a staggered grid. Same saddle-point structure as staggered Poisson with Helmholtz operator.

docs.title: 1. Governing Equation
docs.text:
First-order system: \(g_x = \partial_x u\), \(g_y = \partial_y u\), \(\partial_t u - \alpha(\partial_x g_x + \partial_y g_y) = f\).

Implicit Euler saddle-point system:

\[\begin{bmatrix} I & 0 & -G_x \\ 0 & I & -G_y \\ -\alpha\Delta t D_x & -\alpha\Delta t D_y & I \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} g_x \\ g_y \\ u \end{bmatrix}^{n+1} = \begin{bmatrix} b_{gx} \\ b_{gy} \\ u^n + \Delta t f \end{bmatrix}\]

Same 3 MMS as vertex heat.

docs.title: 2. Discretization
docs.text:
• Grid: Same staggered layout as staggered Poisson
  • Matrix: \(u\)-block has identity diagonal — no regularization needed (unlike Poisson)
  • Dirichlet BC: \(g_x - \frac{2}{h}u_0 = -\frac{2}{h}g\) at boundary faces
  • Neumann BC: \(g_x = \mp g\) at boundary faces (identity row)
  • Solver: PCLU direct solver, tolerance \(10^{-12}\)

docs.title: Stokes Projection Solver
docs.text: Unsteady Stokes flow via Chorin's projection method on a staggered (MAC) grid. Fractional-step: viscous → pressure Poisson → correction.

docs.title: 1. Governing Equation
docs.text:
\[ rac{\partial \mathbf{u}}{\partial t} = u\Delta\mathbf{u} - abla p + \mathbf{f}, \quad abla\cdot\mathbf{u} = 0\]

Manufactured solution (built-in):

\[u = e^{-2\pi^2 u t}\sin(\pi x)\cos(\pi y),\quad v = -e^{-2\pi^2 u t}\cos(\pi x)\sin(\pi y),\quad p = 0\]

\( u = 0.1\), homogeneous Dirichlet on velocity, \(T_{ ext{final}} = 0.01\).

docs.title: 2. Numerical Method
docs.text:
• Grid: \(u\) at x-faces, \(v\) at y-faces, \(p\) at cell centers, \(h = 1/N\)
  • Step 1 (Viscous): \((I - u\Delta t\Delta)\mathbf{u}^* = \mathbf{u}^n\) — Red-Black Gauss-Seidel
  • Step 2 (Projection): \(\Delta p = rac{1}{\Delta t} abla\cdot\mathbf{u}^*\)
  • Step 3 (Correction): \(\mathbf{u}^{n+1} = \mathbf{u}^* - \Delta t\, abla p\)
  • Time: \(\Delta t = h^2\)

docs.title: Stokes Monolithic Solver
docs.text: Steady/unsteady Stokes via a monolithic saddle-point system. All DOFs \((u, v, p)\) solved simultaneously.

docs.title: 1. Governing Equation
docs.text:
Same Stokes equations as projection method. Implicit Euler saddle-point:

\[\begin{bmatrix} I - \nu\Delta t\Delta & 0 & \Delta t\,G_x \\ 0 & I - \nu\Delta t\Delta & \Delta t\,G_y \\ -D_x & -D_y & \varepsilon I \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} u \\ v \\ p \end{bmatrix}^{n+1} = \begin{bmatrix} u^n \\ v^n \\ 0 \end{bmatrix}\]

\(\varepsilon = 10^{-8}\) on pressure diagonal (stabilization). \(\Delta t = h^2\), \(T_{\text{final}} = 0.01\).

docs.title: 2. Numerical Method
docs.text:
• Grid: Same staggered layout — \(u\) (x-faces), \(v\) (y-faces), \(p\) (cell centers)
  • Pressure pinning: \(p(0,0) = 0\) removes constant nullspace
  • Matrix: Manual assembly, DOFs \(= (N_x+1)N_y + N_x(N_y+1) + N_x N_y\)
  • Solver: GMRES + ILU, tolerance \(10^{-10}\)

docs.title: 3. Convergence Results
docs.text:
$ ./stokes_monolithic_2D -nx 16 -ny 16 -stokes_check_error

而我们使用的 \(\Delta t = 2.44 \times 10^{-5}\) 远小于此限制（为了精度而非稳定性）。

docs.title: 问题描述
docs.text:
求解二维热传导方程：

\[\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} = \alpha \Delta u + f\]

其中： - \(u(x, y, t)\) 是温度场 - \(\alpha\) 是热扩散系数 - \(f(x, y, t)\) 是源项 - 边界条件：\(u = 0\) on \(\partial\Omega\) (齐次 Dirichlet 边界条件) - 初始条件：\(u(x, y, 0) = \sin(\pi x) \sin(\pi y)\)

docs.title: 精确解
docs.text:
使用分离变量法，在无源项 (\(f = 0\)) 的情况下，精确解为：

\[u_{\text{exact}}(x, y, t) = e^{-2\pi^2\alpha t} \sin(\pi x) \sin(\pi y)\]

docs.title: 时间离散化
docs.text:
使用隐式欧拉法（向后欧拉）：

\[\frac{u^{n+1} - u^n}{\Delta t} = \alpha \Delta u^{n+1} + f^{n+1}\]

重新整理为 Helmholtz 方程：

\[(I - \alpha \Delta t \Delta) u^{n+1} = u^n + \Delta t f^{n+1}\]

或者：

\[u^{n+1} - \alpha \Delta t \Delta u^{n+1} = u^n + \Delta t f^{n+1}\]

docs.title: 空间离散化
docs.text:
• 使用 DMStag 的单元中心网格（cell-centered grid）
  • 五点差分格式离散化拉普拉斯算子
  • 虚拟单元法处理 Dirichlet 边界条件：\(u_{\text{ghost}} = -u_{\text{interior}}\)

docs.title: 线性系统求解
docs.text:
每个时间步需要求解 Helmholtz 方程：

\[(I + \alpha \Delta t L) u^{n+1} = u^n + \Delta t f\]

其中 \(L\) 是离散拉普拉斯算子矩阵。

使用 红黑 Gauss-Seidel 迭代法进行 matrix-free 求解：

\[u_{\text{new}} = \frac{u^n + \Delta t f + \alpha \Delta t \cdot \frac{1}{h^2}(u_l + u_r + u_d + u_u)}{1 + 4\alpha \Delta t / h^2}\]

docs.title: 预期结果
docs.text:
对于二阶精度方法（空间和时间都是二阶），误差应该满足：

\[\|u - u_{\text{exact}}\|_{L^2} = O(h^2 + \Delta t)\]

当 \(\Delta t \propto h^2\) 时，误差为 \(O(h^2)\)，即网格加密2倍，误差减小4倍。

docs.title: 主要函数
docs.text:
1. SetupInitialCondition: 设置初始条件 \(u(x,y,0) = \sin(\pi x)\sin(\pi y)\)

  2. SetupRHS: 设置源项 \(f(x,y,t)\)（本例中为0）

  3. GaussSeidelSweep: 执行一次红黑 Gauss-Seidel 扫描

  4. 求解 \((I + \alpha \Delta t L) u^{n+1} = u^n + \Delta t f\)

  5. 使用虚拟单元法处理边界条件

  6. ComputeResidualNorm: 计算残差范数

  7. 残差：\(r = (u^n + \Delta t f) - (I + \alpha \Delta t L) u^{n+1}\)

  8. ComputeL2Error: 计算与精确解的 L2 误差

  9. \(\|u - u_{\text{exact}}\|_{L^2} = \sqrt{h_x h_y} \|u - u_{\text{exact}}\|_{\ell^2}\)

docs.title: 时间演化循环
docs.text:
while (t < T_final) {
  t += dt;
  VecCopy(u, uOld);                    // 保存上一步解
  SetupRHS(dm, f, fLocal, t);          // 更新源项

  // Gauss-Seidel 迭代求解 Helmholtz 方程
  for (its = 1; its <= maxIts; ++its) {
    GaussSeidelSweep(...);
    ComputeResidualNorm(...);
    if (resNorm <= tol) break;
  }
}

docs.title: 稳定性分析
docs.text:
隐式欧拉法是无条件稳定的，不受 CFL 条件限制。

对于显式方法（如向前欧拉），稳定性条件为：

\[\Delta t \leq \frac{h^2}{4\alpha}\]

而隐式方法允许使用更大的时间步长，但每步需要求解线性系统。

docs.text:

  3. 非均匀扩散系数：\(\alpha = \alpha(x, y)\)
  4. 输出可视化：集成 VTI 输出功能
  5. 预条件器：使用 PETSc KSP 求解器替代 Gauss-Seidel
  6. 自适应时间步长：根据误差估计调整 \(\Delta t\)

docs.title: Poisson 方程的相容性条件
问题描述
docs.text:
对于带有纯 Neumann 边界条件的 Poisson 方程：

\[ \begin{cases} \nabla^2 p = f & \text{in } \Omega \\ \frac{\partial p}{\partial n} = 0 & \text{on } \partial\Omega \end{cases} \]

该问题有解当且仅当右端项 \(f\) 满足以下相容性条件（compatibility condition）：

\[ \int_\Omega f \, dV = 0 \]

docs.title: 数学推导
docs.text:
使用散度定理（divergence theorem）：

\[ \int_\Omega abla^2 p \, dV = \int_{\partial\Omega} rac{\partial p}{\partial n} \, dS \]

由于边界条件 \( rac{\partial p}{\partial n} = 0\)，右边为零：

\[ \int_\Omega abla^2 p \, dV = 0 \]

将 Poisson 方程 \( abla^2 p = f\) 代入：

\[ \int_\Omega f \, dV = 0 \]

结论：如果 \(\int_\Omega f \, dV eq 0\)，方程无解！

docs.title: 物理意义
docs.text:
在流体力学中，Poisson 方程通常用于压力修正：

\[ abla^2 p = abla \cdot \mathbf{u}^* \]

其中 \(\mathbf{u}^*\) 是中间速度场。相容性条件意味着：

  • 不可压缩流动：\( abla \cdot \mathbf{u} = 0\)，所以 \(\int abla \cdot \mathbf{u}^* \, dV = 0\)
  • 通过求解 Poisson 方程得到压力场，然后修正速度使其满足无散度条件

docs.title: 解的唯一性
docs.text:
对于纯 Neumann 边界条件： - 解不是唯一的：如果 \(p\) 是解，那么 \(p + C\)（任意常数）也是解 - 解只在常数意义下唯一

为了得到唯一解，需要额外约束： 1. 固定一点的值：\(p(x_0, y_0) = 0\) 2. 强制零均值：\(\int_\Omega p \, dV = 0\)

docs.title: 问题诊断
docs.text:
当使用迭代法（如 Gauss-Seidel）求解纯 Neumann Poisson 方程时：

现象： - 残差不收敛，卡在某个较大的值 - 每次迭代残差几乎不变

原因： 1. RHS 不满足相容性条件：\(\int f \, dV \neq 0\) 2. 常数零空间未被移除

docs.title: 1. 强制 RHS 满足相容性条件
docs.text:
在每个时间步求解 Poisson 方程前：

// 计算 RHS 的积分
PetscScalar divSum;
PetscCall(VecSum(div, &divSum));

// 计算并移除平均值
const PetscScalar divMean = divSum / (Nx * Ny);
PetscCall(VecShift(div, -divMean));

docs.title: 2. 移除解的常数零空间
docs.text:
在每次迭代后强制解的零均值：

PetscErrorCode PoissonZero(const DM &dm, Vec &u, Vec &uLocal, 
                           PetscInt Nx, PetscInt Ny) {
  // 1. 计算所有 element center DOFs 的平均值
  PetscScalar localSum = 0.0;
  for (PetscInt ey = starty; ey < starty + ny; ++ey) {
    for (PetscInt ex = startx; ex < startx + nx; ++ex) {
      localSum += aU[ey][ex][icenter];
    }
  }

  // 2. 全局归约
  PetscScalar globalSum;
  MPI_Allreduce(&localSum, &globalSum, 1, MPIU_SCALAR, MPI_SUM, comm);
  const PetscScalar average = globalSum / (Nx * Ny);

  // 3. 从所有值中减去平均值
  for (PetscInt ey = starty; ey < starty + ny; ++ey) {
    for (PetscInt ex = startx; ex < startx + nx; ++ex) {
      aU[ey][ex][icenter] -= average;
    }
  }
}

docs.title: 3. 迭代过程
docs.text:
for (int iter = 1; iter <= maxIter; ++iter) {
  // Gauss-Seidel sweep
  GaussSeidelSweep_Poisson(...);

  // 移除常数零空间（关键！）
  PoissonZero(dm, u, uLocal, Nx, Ny);

  // 计算残差
  CalculateResidual_Poisson(..., &residualNorm);

  if (residualNorm < tolerance) break;
}

docs.title: 示例：Taylor-Green Vortex
docs.text: Taylor-Green vortex 是一个满足相容性条件的经典解析解：

docs.title: 速度场
docs.text: \[ \begin{align} u(x,y,t) &= -\cos(\pi x) \sin(\pi y) e^{-2\pi^2 \nu t} \\ v(x,y,t) &= \sin(\pi x) \cos(\pi y) e^{-2\pi^2 \nu t} \end{align} \]

docs.title: 散度
docs.text:
\[ \nabla \cdot \mathbf{u} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = 0 \]

散度恒为零，自动满足相容性条件！

docs.title: 压力场
docs.text:
\[ p(x,y,t) = -\frac{1}{4}[\cos(2\pi x) + \cos(2\pi y)] e^{-4\pi^2 \nu t} \]

压力满足零均值：\(\int_\Omega p \, dV = 0\)

docs.title: 错误 1：使用不满足相容性的 RHS
docs.text:
// ❌ 错误：cos(x)cos(y) 的积分不为零
aDiv[ey][ex][ip] = std::cos(x) * std::cos(y);

// 积分：∫∫ cos(x)cos(y) dx dy = [sin(1)]^2 ≈ 0.708 ≠ 0

结果：迭代不收敛，残差停滞

docs.title: 错误 2：忘记调用 PoissonZero
docs.text:
for (int iter = 1; iter <= maxIter; ++iter) {
  GaussSeidelSweep_Poisson(...);
  // ❌ 忘记移除零空间
  CalculateResidual_Poisson(...);
}

结果：即使 RHS 满足相容性条件，迭代仍可能不收敛

docs.title: 错误 3：PoissonZero 实现错误
docs.text:
// ❌ 错误：使用局部 nx*ny 而非全局 Nx*Ny
PetscInt totalCells = nx * ny;  // 局部大小
PetscScalar average = globalSum / totalCells;  // 错误的平均值

结果：平均值计算错误，零空间未被正确移除

docs.title: 总结
docs.text:
• 纯 Neumann Poisson 方程需要 RHS 满足 \(\int f dV = 0\)
  • 解只在常数意义下唯一，需要额外约束（如零均值）
  • 数值求解时必须：
  • 强制 RHS 零均值
  • 每次迭代后移除解的零空间
  • Taylor-Green vortex 是理想的测试用例（自然满足相容性条件）

docs.title: Poisson 方程收敛性测试结果
问题描述
docs.text:
求解二维 Poisson 方程： $\(-\Delta u = f\)$

其中： - 区域: \(\Omega = [0,1] \times [0,1]\) - 边界条件: \(u = 0\) on \(\partial\Omega\) (齐次 Dirichlet) - 精确解: \(u(x,y) = \sin(\pi x) \sin(\pi y)\) - 源项: \(f(x,y) = 2\pi^2 \sin(\pi x) \sin(\pi y)\)

docs.title: 数值方法
docs.text:
• 空间离散: DMStag 单元中心网格，五点差分格式
  • 边界条件: 虚拟单元法 (\(u_{\text{ghost}} = -u_{\text{interior}}\))
  • 线性求解器: 红黑 Gauss-Seidel 迭代
  • 收敛容差: \(\|r\|_2 < 10^{-8}\)

docs.text:
网格加密 误差减小因子 理论值 (2²) 16→32 4.01 4.0 32→64 4.01 4.0 64→128 4.00 4.0

结论: ✅ 网格加密 2 倍，误差减小 4 倍，完美符合二阶方法！

docs.title: 计算时间估算
docs.text: 假设每次迭代的时间复杂度为 \(O(N^2)\)： - 总时间复杂度: \(O(N^2) \times O(N^2) = O(N^4)\) - 这说明对于大规模问题，需要更高效的求解器（如多重网格法）

docs.title: 五点差分格式
docs.text:
对于 Poisson 方程 \(-\Delta u = f\)，五点差分格式为：

\[\frac{-u_{i-1,j} + 2u_{i,j} - u_{i+1,j}}{h_x^2} + \frac{-u_{i,j-1} + 2u_{i,j} - u_{i,j+1}}{h_y^2} = f_{i,j}\]

docs.title: 截断误差
docs.text:
Taylor 展开分析表明： $\(\tau = O(h^2)\)$

因此期望 L2 范数误差： $\(\|u - u_h\|_{L^2} = O(h^2)\)$

实验结果完美验证了这一理论！

docs.title: 单元中心网格的挑战
docs.text: 对于单元中心网格，物理边界上没有网格点。边界条件需要通过虚拟单元实现。

if (ex == 0) {
  ul = -aU[ey][ex][icenter];  // u_{-1,j} = -u_{0,j}

docs.title: Poisson Equation with Neumann Boundary Conditions
Overview
docs.text: This document describes the implementation of a Poisson equation solver with homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions (∂u/∂n = 0) and comparison with Dirichlet boundary conditions.

docs.title: 1. Manufactured Solution (Neumann BC)
docs.text:
Added to manufactured_solutions.h:

namespace POISSON::NEUMANN_2D {
  // Exact solution: u(x,y) = cos(πx)cos(πy)
  static inline PetscScalar u_exact(PetscScalar x, PetscScalar y);

  // Right-hand side: f(x,y) = 2π²cos(πx)cos(πy)
  static inline PetscScalar rhs_f(PetscScalar x, PetscScalar y);

  // Gradient functions for verification
  static inline PetscScalar dudx(PetscScalar x, PetscScalar y);
  static inline PetscScalar dudy(PetscScalar x, PetscScalar y);
}

Key Properties: - The solution satisfies ∂u/∂n = 0 at all boundaries (x=0, x=1, y=0, y=1) - cos(πx) has zero derivative at x=0 and x=1 - cos(πy) has zero derivative at y=0 and y=1

docs.title: 2. Solver Implementation
docs.text: Added to unified_pde_solver_2D.cpp:

docs.text:

docs.title: Gauss-Seidel Solver
docs.text:
PetscErrorCode GaussSeidelSweep_Poisson_Neumann(const DM &dm, Vec &u, Vec &uLocal,
                                                 const Vec &f, const Vec &fLocal,
                                                 PetscInt Nx, PetscInt Ny)
- Implements Neumann BC by setting ghost cell values equal to interior cells - For Neumann BC: u_ghost = u_interior (∂u/∂n ≈ 0) - Contrast with Dirichlet BC: u_ghost = -u_interior (u = 0 at boundary)

docs.text:
Problem formulation:

∂u/∂n = 0          on ∂Ω

Note: For pure Neumann problems, solution is unique only up to a constant. The manufactured solution is chosen such that it naturally satisfies the boundary conditions.

docs.title: Finite Difference Discretization
docs.text:
At boundary (e.g., x = 0): 

Dirichlet (u=0):   u_ghost = -u_interior
Neumann (∂u/∂n=0): u_ghost = u_interior

The stencil at boundary cells: - Dirichlet: contribution from ghost cells effectively cancels interior value - Neumann: ghost cells contribute as if boundary extends uniformly

docs.title: 项目概述
docs.text:
本项目构建了一套跨平台高性能科学计算软件栈，以 Kokkos 作为并行计算后端，PETSc 作为分布式计算基础设施，最终目标是实现一个通用的、基于交错网格（Staggered Grid/DMStag）的 PDE 求解框架。

docs.title: 1. Poisson 方程
docs.text:
问题: \(-\Delta u = f\)，齐次 Dirichlet 边界条件

数值方法: - 空间离散: DMStag 单元中心五点差分（二阶精度） - 边界处理: 虚拟单元法 (\(u_{\text{ghost}} = -u_{\text{interior}}\)) - 线性求解: KSP (GMRES / 红黑 Gauss-Seidel)

验证结果: 使用制造解 \(u = \sin(\pi x)\sin(\pi y)\)，确认达到二阶收敛。

docs.title: 2. 热传导方程
docs.text:
问题: \(\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} = \alpha \Delta u + f\)

数值方法: - 时间离散: 隐式 Euler（一阶）/ Crank-Nicolson（二阶） - 空间离散: 五点差分（二阶） - 每个时间步求解 Helmholtz 方程 \((I - \alpha\Delta t\Delta)u^{n+1} = u^n + \Delta t f^{n+1}\)

验证结果: 使用 \(\Delta t \propto h^2\) 的耦合收敛测试，达到二阶收敛。

docs.title: 3. Stokes 方程
docs.text:
问题: $\(\begin{cases} -\Delta \mathbf{u} + \nabla p = \mathbf{f} \\ \nabla \cdot \mathbf{u} = 0 \end{cases}\)$

数值方法: - 交错网格 (MAC grid): 速度在面心，压力在单元中心 - 时间推进: 投影法 (Projection Method) - 压力 Poisson 方程使用 KSP 求解

docs.title: 4. 非线性系统 (JFNK)
docs.text: Jacobian-Free Newton-Krylov 方法: - 外层 Newton 迭代求解 \(F(u) = 0\) - 内层 GMRES 求解线性化系统，无需显式构造 Jacobian 矩阵 - 使用有限差分近似 Jacobian-vector 乘积

docs.title: 5. 弹簧-质点链动力学
docs.text: 模拟竖直悬挂的 N 个弹簧-质点系统的二维运动，用于验证非线性动力学求解能力。

docs.text: 通过 Python 脚本自动生成 C++ 解析解头文件 (unsteady.h)，包含： - Taylor-Green 2D 涡的精确解 - 各方程的制造解 (Manufactured Solution) 源项 - 支持 Poisson、Heat、Stokes、Navier-Stokes 方程
